name: semantic-default-changed
description: Upstream changes slugify's default separator to '_' (file names); the change builds permalinks with the default and expects dashes. The fix is to pass '-' explicitly in the new code, not to revert upstream.

plan.title: Underscore slugs by default
plan.intent: Exported file names must not contain dashes, so slugify() joins with '_' by default. URL builders that need dashes pass '-' explicitly.

plan.title: Word count helper
plan.intent: Show the number of words of a post title.
